If this urge is immediate, move the safety pin and any other sharp items away from you, go where another person is present, and contact emergency services now, or call or text
988
if you are in the United States or Canada. The 988 Lifeline is free, confidential, and available 24/7. If you are elsewhere, Befrienders Worldwide can help you find a local crisis line.
988 Lifeline

“I am not safe being alone right now. Please stay with me.”
